Loading effects also remain family-specific: m79 outcome a0b74d39650c8173ca91 and m112 outcome 4319c2f6bd0d3d2094a4 do not show the same broad displacement as the tail-prone m125, m82, and m186 records. I therefore emphasize matched nitrogen, EA, m72/m82, donor, and nitro-carbonyl curves while retaining compact anchors.","batch_rationale":"The batch concentrates measurements where the current model can learn transferable response surfaces rather than isolated maximum-volume examples. Four compact controls constrain the ordinary Row-distribution; four m11 cells and two m141 cells map basic-nitrogen transitions; three m92 EA cells test a distinct loading-solvent response; m78, m82, m72, m198, m193, and m99 cells target high-width completion and loading regimes; and m135/m207 cells test donor attachment geometry. Several groups form local ratio or loading curves, allowing the retrained model to distinguish smooth trends from thresholds. The resulting diversity is tied to observed failure modes and includes compact calibration so improvements in delayed subsets do not degrade the much larger compact population."}
